meta.attribution: Meta Ads Manager, 7-day click and 1-day view

headline: A strong week: we spent 9% more and ROAS still climbed to 2.71x, thanks to two founder-led videos that are now carrying 38% of the account.
takeaways: ROAS hit 2.71x, above the 2.5x goal for the third week running, while spend rose to $48.2K.
Founder-led video is the clear winner. The two "Why I made this" cuts did $18.4K at 3.12x combined.
The holiday gift-set statics are tiring. Hook rate on the top one fell from 31% to 22% in two weeks, so we're refreshing them before Q4 spend ramps.

kpis.label: ROAS
kpis.note: Our north star. Third straight week above goal.

kpis.label: Hook rate
kpis.note: Video only. Dipped as the gift statics' video cuts tired.

trend.read: Spend is up 33% over eight weeks and ROAS went up with it, from 2.21x to 2.71x. That's the good kind of growth. Usually more spend pulls efficiency down, so this tells us the new creative is finding fresh buyers, not just hitting the same people harder.

top_creatives.name: Founder story: Why I made this (60s)
top_creatives.why: Opens on Maya's hands mixing a batch in her kitchen, then says "my skin cracked every winter for ten years." Real story, real problem, product shown in use by second four. It's pulling a younger crowd than our usual statics.
top_creatives.basis: Verified: week spend and metrics from search_facebook_ads_sql; description from the ad's transcript and AI analysis (adIds fetch).

top_creatives.name: Founder story: 15s cutdown
top_creatives.why: Same opening as the 60s with the middle cut out. Meta is putting it mostly in Reels, where the shorter length holds people better.
top_creatives.basis: Verified: week spend and metrics from search_facebook_ads_sql; description from the ad's transcript and AI analysis (adIds fetch).

top_creatives.name: Review wall: 4,000 five-star reviews
top_creatives.why: Our most reliable static for 11 weeks. Real review quotes stacked over the product. It brings in returning visitors who need one more nudge.
top_creatives.basis: Verified: week spend and metrics from search_facebook_ads_sql; description from the ad's transcript and AI analysis (adIds fetch).

launches.summary: Our biggest launch week in two months. Most of it went to two tests: a fresh round of founder-video hooks, and three new gift-set carousels ahead of Q4.

early_signals.name: Founder hook test: "My dermatologist laughed at me"
early_signals.note: Best early hook rate of the batch at 41% on $620. Too early to call on purchases.

early_signals.name: Gift-set carousel: Stocking stuffers under $30
early_signals.note: Strong click rate (1.9%) but only 3 purchases so far. Watching the landing page.

watch_list.name: Gift set static: The cozy bundle
watch_list.evidence: Hook rate dropped from 31% to 22% over two weeks, and frequency is up to 2.1. Still at 2.2x ROAS, so it's not losing money yet.
watch_list.action: Keep it on, but launch the two refreshed versions Monday so they can take over before it slips below goal.

watch_list.name: Lifestyle video: Cabin morning routine
watch_list.evidence: Spent $2,380 this week at 1.4x ROAS, well under our 2.5x goal, and it's not improving after three weeks.
watch_list.action: Turn it off. The idea isn't wrong, but this version isn't working. We'll fold the best shot into a founder-video test instead.

format_mix.title: Where the spend went
format_mix.read: Nearly half the money now goes to UGC video, and it's also our most efficient format. Lifestyle video is the drag at 9% of spend and 1.62x.

insights.title: People want the person behind the brand
insights.body: Both top ads lead with Maya, the founder. Ads with her on camera averaged 3.1x ROAS this week, against 2.4x for everything else. Her story does work our product shots can't.
insights.basis: Verified: founder-tagged ads vs the rest, spend-weighted ROAS from the week's pull.

insights.title: The winter skin problem is our best opening
insights.body: The three best hooks this week all name cracked or dry winter skin in the first line. That lines up with what customers say in reviews, where "winter" shows up in 1 out of every 6.
insights.basis: Verified: hook text of the top three by hook rate; review share from search_customer_reviews_sql. Inferred: the link between the two.

insights.title: Gift buyers click but take longer to buy
insights.body: The gift carousels get lots of clicks but slow purchases so far. That's normal this early in the season. We'll judge them in two weeks, not now.
insights.basis: Inferred: gift carousels' click rate vs purchase count this week, read against seasonality.md's Q4 lag.
